title: QuantumCTek
summary: China's listed quantum key distribution equipment supplier.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

QuantumCTek sells quantum key distribution hardware and network equipment, largely to government and utility customers in China. Revenue is small and project-based, tied to national quantum communication networks rather than commercial demand. It is the clearest listed proxy for state-backed quantum networking, which is a different business from quantum computing.

Technology Exposure

  • QKD terminals and metropolitan network equipment.
  • Quantum-safe communication for state and utility networks.

What To Watch

  • Project awards and recognition timing.
  • Whether QKD wins against post-quantum cryptography in commercial networks.

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 18 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.

businessMeaning: QKD solves key distribution only; it does not protect stored data, and post-quantum cryptography is the cheaper default for most enterprises.
investmentLens: A policy-order business with lumpy revenue; size positions to project cycles, not to a TAM story.
